action_items: AI Skill Gap Analyzer, CAPACITY AI, and AI Assessment Generator are deterministic MOCKED prototype responses per specification; no external AI provider is integrated.
Charts and heatmap values are realistic demo/sample data and labeled as platform-measured/prototype signals.

checks.name: admin-intelligence-impact
